extension.summary: Free movies and TV shows from Fawesome (unofficial)
extension.description:
Browse and play Fawesome's free, on-demand catalogue of movies and TV shows: Home, Collections, Shows, Movies, En Español and Handpicked rows, with search, seasons and episodes, and subtitles where Fawesome has them. No account or sign-up -- Fawesome has none.
Streams are plain HLS played through InputStream Adaptive; no DRM module is needed.
Known gaps: Fawesome is ad-supported and its web player requests ads separately from the video (client-side VMAP). This add-on plays the programme stream only and does not insert those ads. The FAST linear channels on Fawesome's TV apps are not included. Fawesome is US-centric; its catalogue may differ or be unavailable elsewhere.
This add-on uses Fawesome's undocumented website API and may need updating when the site changes.
extension.disclaimer: Unofficial. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Future Today Inc. Fawesome is a trademark of Future Today Inc.
extension.news: 2026.11.21 (.3) - Skip intro and Next episode - Skip intro while a title's intro plays, and at the credits of an episode a Next episode countdown with Watch credits -- from Fawesome's own intro and credits times, the way its website does it (Skip Buttons module). - Episodes without a credits time play the next episode when they end. Turn this off with "Autoplay next episode" in the settings. - Restart Kodi once after installing or updating so the new background service starts. 2026.11.21 (.2) - My List - A "My List" row on the home screen, plus "Add to My List" / "Remove from My List" on each title's context menu. Saved per device (Fawesome has no account), using its own queue, so it persists on this install. 2026.11.21 - First test build - Browse Fawesome's sections and rows, genre lists and collections, shows by season, and search; play titles as clear HLS through InputStream Adaptive. - Subtitles are labelled by language and offered in your Kodi language, then English, first (downloaded as language-named files, since Fawesome's caption URLs carry no language). One-season shows open straight to their episodes. - Robust against Fawesome shipping a new site build: an API 404 re-reads the current build and retries, instead of breaking until the cache expires. - Known gaps: one muxed audio track per title (no alternate audio exists); ad insertion and the TV apps' FAST channels are not included.
